outcome.label: Done - here is what gives
outcome.meaning: We found the whole increase in your other spending, and nothing dropped below what your city says it costs.

hints.label: Rent
hints.hint: a roommate, or renegotiating the lease at renewal, is the only real lever here - the monthly figure itself will not move

hints.label: Healthcare
hints.hint: comparing plans at renewal, and asking for generic medication, are where this actually moves

hints.label: Utilities
hints.hint: off-peak tariffs and replacing the bulbs you leave on typically cut 10-15%, and comparing providers is worth an hour once a year

hints.label: Groceries
hints.hint: own-brand staples and one planned weekly shop instead of several small ones is where this moves, not skipping meals

hints.label: Transport
hints.hint: a monthly pass usually beats single fares once you travel more than about three days a week

hints.label: Everything else
hints.hint: we could not tell what this spending was, so the first lever is naming it - once it has a name there is something to decide about

hints.label: Gym membership
hints.hint: off-peak or annual-paid memberships are usually 20-30% cheaper than the monthly rate for exactly the same thing
